>_ Episode 11 · Sep 18, 2026 · 1h 56m

Doom Debate Prep

Play Episode 11 on YouTube
Watch on YouTube SpotifyApple Podcasts

In this episode, Casey(@OntologyExplained) and Carl(@InternetOfBugs) prep for Casey's upcoming debate on (@DoomDebates) with Liron Shapira. They dive into what "P-Doom" actually means, break down the feasibility of recursive self-improvement (RSI), and evaluate whether recent breakthroughs—like AI-assisted Lean proofs for Navier–Stokes—actually point toward artificial superintelligence or just sophisticated, narrow mixtures of experts. Along the way, they analyze the incentives driving public AI panic, the rhetorical tactics of the rationalist community, and why focusing on speculative existential risk often distracts from tangible, real-world AI harms.
